title: Question 20
passage:
Where should I put the flyers if it starts to rain?
A. We have a hundred copies left. B. I only brought one umbrella. C. Under the awning by the door.
passageZh:
如果開始下雨，我該把傳單放到哪裡？
A. 我們還剩一百張。 B. 我只帶了一把傘。 C. 放在門旁的遮雨棚下。
